options.A: the results of a questionnaire survey

57.question: Participant observation is the kind of observation in which...

options.A: the observer records events from the outside without making contact
options.B: observation is conducted only from video recordings of events
options.C: recording follows strictly a predetermined scheme
options.D: the observed themselves fill in registration cards
options.E: the researcher personally takes part in the life of the observed group

60.question: What does the sociological term “sample” imply?

options.A: A part of the general population selected by special procedures
options.B: The entire population of people about which the study's conclusions are drawn
options.C: A procedure for testing the reliability of a questionnaire in a pilot survey
options.D: The final table of the distribution of respondents' answers by group
options.E: A statistical hypothesis about the relationship between two variables in the data

82.question: A hypothesis of a sociological study is...

options.A: a statement of the aim and concept with a sequence of verification operations
options.B: a really existing contradiction whose means of resolution are unclear
options.C: a reasoned assumption about the structure of the object and its mechanism of functioning
options.D: a set of units about which the conclusions of the survey are drawn
options.E: a transition from concepts to indicators that make it possible to collect data

options.A: random selection of units from the general population for a survey
options.B: formulating the aim and objectives of the study in its program
options.C: statistical processing of the collected data in special software
options.D: confirming hypotheses by means of statistical significance tests
options.E: translating theoretical concepts into indicators and measurement tools

84.question: The general population in a sample study is...

options.A: the set of units about which the conclusions of the survey are drawn
options.B: the part of the units actually surveyed by the researcher during the survey
options.C: the list of indicators measured in a questionnaire and in an interview
options.D: the group of experts involved for interviews and consultations
options.E: the number of respondents who refused to take part in the survey

86.question: The method of direct registration of people's actions and interactions in a particular situation is called...

87.question: Discussion of the topic under study by a small group of participants led by a moderator is the basis of the method of...

options.A: the units are selected by experts at their own discretion, based on ease of access
options.B: only volunteers who responded to a posted announcement are included in the sample
options.C: absolutely all units of the general population are surveyed, not a part of them
options.D: the composition of the sample is set by quotas for sex and age and does not depend on chance
options.E: every unit has a known non-zero probability of being included in the sample

89.question: What is a sample in a sociological study?

options.A: The main document with the aims, hypotheses, objectives and plan of the study
options.B: A part of the general population formed according to special rules
options.C: A property of data to reproduce the characteristics of the whole population
options.D: A written survey using a standardized questionnaire with closed questions
options.E: A reasoned assumption about the structure and properties of the object under study

166.question: Which of the following research principles differs from the others in its methodological basis?

options.A: Measurability of phenomena and statistical processing of the data obtained
options.B: Interpretation of the meanings and experience of people in a particular context
options.C: Social determinism as the basis of the experimental method
options.D: Identification of cause-and-effect relationships between phenomena and variables
options.E: Generalization of conclusions to the general population from a sample

169.question: Which change in research conditions directly limits the possibility of statistically extending the results of a sample study to the general population?

options.A: Increasing the sample size while keeping random selection and known probabilities
options.B: Using a written instead of an oral survey with the same sample and the same selection
options.C: Forming the sample by ease of access, when the probability of units being included is unknown
options.D: Applying a stratified random sample instead of a simple random sample
options.E: Using a standardized questionnaire instead of a free interview on the same questions

178.question: Which statement most accurately expresses the relationship between theoretical concepts and empirical indicators in social research?

options.A: Indicators are derived from respondents' answers and do not depend on theoretical concepts
options.B: Concepts coincide with indicators and are measured directly, without additional procedures
options.C: Indicators are chosen after data collection so that they confirm the hypothesis
options.D: Concepts are operationalized into indicators, which are then used to test hypotheses
options.E: Indicators replace theory, since applied research does not need it
